faq.subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team.

1.question: How does Tijraa work?
1.answer: Tijraa allows you to create and manage multiple online stores from one powerful platform. Simply create your store, customize it with your products and branding, and start selling!

2.question: Is my data secure?
2.answer: Yes, we use enterprise-grade security measures to protect your data. All information is encrypted and stored securely. You have full control over your privacy settings.

3.question: Can I customize my online store?
3.answer: Absolutely! You can customize colors, fonts, layout, add your logo, product images, and much more. Our platform offers extensive customization options.

4.question: Do I need technical skills to use Tijraa?
4.answer: Not at all! Tijraa is designed to be user-friendly. You can create and manage your online stores in minutes without any technical knowledge.

5.question: Can I track my store performance?
5.answer: Yes, our analytics feature allows you to track sales, views, clicks, and engagement metrics so you can understand how your customers interact with your stores.

faq.title: Billing questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about plans and payments.

trial.question: Can I try Tijraa before paying?
trial.answer: Yes. Plans that offer a trial let you build and preview your store before you're charged, so you can see how everything works first.

switch.question: Can I change plans later?
switch.answer: Anytime. Upgrade from your dashboard as you grow, or move to a smaller plan if your needs change.

fees.question: Are there setup or hidden fees?
fees.answer: No setup fees and no surprises. You pay the plan price; your payment gateway may charge its own standard processing fees.

payment.question: How can I pay for my plan?
payment.answer: Pay by card or any of the payment methods enabled for your region. Yearly billing is available on plans that support it.

cancel.question: What happens if I cancel?
cancel.answer: Your store stays active until the end of the paid period. You can export your data and come back whenever you like.

story.title: Selling online shouldn't need a technical team
story.p1: Tijraa started with a simple observation: great local businesses were held back by platforms that weren't built for their language, their payment methods or the way their customers shop.
story.p2: So we built one platform that handles the storefront, checkout and operations, and added an AI copilot that works from your own data — so merchants can spend their time on products and customers, not configuration.

local.title: Local by default
local.description: Arabic, RTL, regional gateways and WhatsApp are core features, not afterthoughts.

simple.title: Simple beats clever
simple.description: If a merchant needs a manual to do something common, we haven't finished designing it.

owned.title: Your store, your data

how.question: How does Tijraa work?
how.answer: Create an account, choose a template, add your products and connect a payment method. Your store is then live on a free subdomain, and you can manage everything — orders, stock, marketing — from one dashboard.

skills.question: Do I need technical skills?
skills.answer: No. Everything is configured through forms and visual editors. If you can use social media, you can run a Tijraa store.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes. Stores run over SSL, payments are handled by certified gateways, and access to your dashboard is controlled by roles and permissions.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: Arabic and English are fully supported with right-to-left layouts, and the dashboard is available in many more languages.

customize.question: Can I customize my store's design?
customize.answer: Yes. Change colors, fonts, logo, sections and layout from the theme editor — no code required.

multiple.question: Can I run more than one store?
multiple.answer: Yes. Depending on your plan you can create several stores under one account, each with its own catalog, theme and domain.

domain.question: Can I use my own domain?
domain.answer: Yes. Every store gets a free subdomain, and plans with custom domains let you connect a domain you already own.

payments.question: Which payment methods can I accept?
payments.answer: Cards, wallets, bank transfer and cash on delivery through a wide range of local and international gateways. You choose which to enable.

analytics.question: Can I track my store's performance?
analytics.answer: Yes. The analytics dashboard shows revenue, orders, conversion and best-selling products over any date range.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: Plans that include a trial let you build and preview your store before you're charged.

switch.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade later?
switch.answer: Yes, at any time from your dashboard.

fees.question: Do you take a cut of my sales?
fees.answer: No. You pay your plan price; payment gateways charge their own standard processing fees.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. Your store stays active until the end of the period you've paid for.

copilot.question: What can Tijraa Copilot do?
copilot.answer: Ask questions about sales, products or customers, draft descriptions and SEO text, and get suggestions to improve your store — all from your own data.

approval.question: Will the AI change my store on its own?
approval.answer: No. AI suggestions wait in the Action Center until you review and approve them.

aiData.question: How is my data used by the AI?
aiData.answer: The assistant only reads the data of the store you're working in to answer your questions. Your store data isn't shared with other merchants.
